notes: Mobile Harness Code — independent fork of Mobile Harness. New: stable background work — returning from another app or the lock screen now refreshes live SSH status (and diagnostics after a long absence) so a tunnel that died in the background no longer shows as "running"; SSH tunnels and the interactive PTY shell are torn down cleanly when the screen closes (no leaked loopback listeners, PTY channels or SSH transports). Fail-closed throughout: the app never auto-reconnects or re-sends credentials — it only refreshes status. Existing tools untouched: providers + AI router/fallback, local model (Ollama), MCP client, RAG, workspace tools, safe Skill system, SSH client/tunnel/TOFU/PTY terminal + keyboard, Phone Control (Shizuku/Wireless ADB/root), in-app update, Telegram bot, multimodal Sidekick, Eco Mode, Share & Invite. This APK is SIGNED (V1+V2+V3); install mobile-harness-online.apk.
